scope: Native transitive dependent-instance effect in the software-unit (TiaMcp_UnitA) and namespace (TiaMcp_UnitA.Alternate) routes: adding one FB member and one static member of each IEC instance type to TgpUnit_NestEffect and TgpNamespace_NestEffect, each embedded as Inner in its route's NestParent and as Middle.Inner in its NestGrand under the namespace-qualified type name, appends each member at the end of every embedded multi-instance's nested Static section in both parent FBs and both parent instance DBs, in the direct instance-DB shape without the top-level AttributeList, Remanence and Accessibility; all other content, start values included, is unchanged (scripts/extract_typed_transitive_effects.py --route softwareUnit|namespace).
limitations: Captured for the software-unit and namespace routes at nesting depths 1 and 2, with every FB of the chain in the same namespace; parents in another namespace or unit are not captured.
